CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   C. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)

4. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   C. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Netball.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)

   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

9. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

12. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

14. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.

   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

15. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)

   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
